name: El Tucan Mariscos
tagline: Sinaloa-style aguachiles and ceviche at Fowler and Grant, weekends until sold out.
about: El Tucan is a mariscos food trailer at the corner of Fowler and Grant in Fresno.
It serves Sinaloa-style seafood, including aguachiles, ceviche and camarones, Friday through Sunday until it sells out. All 55 Facebook reviewers recommend it.
address: Fowler Ave & Grant Ave, Fresno, CA
hours_source: Hours as posted on Facebook, or until sold out.
